number.name: Number
number.description: A number with various formatting options.

date.name: Date
date.description: A date and time field with various formatting options.

toggle.name: Toggle
toggle.description: An on/off value which can be represented as a checkbox, switch, or icon.

color.name: Colour
color.description: A colour assigned to the entry.

image.name: Image
image.description: An image file or reference to an image item type.

tags.name: Tags
tags.description: A list of tags shared across all databases.

icon.name: Icon
icon.description: An icon picker for selecting an icon.

content.name: Content
content.description: The entry's content document, edited using a text editor.

created.name: Created
created.description: Adds the date and time at which an entry was created to its properties.

lastModified.name: Last modified
lastModified.description: Adds the date and time at which an entry was last modified in MindDrop to its properties. Edits made in other apps do not update it.
